sections.Profile:
"Fire!" is a pinball machine designed by Barry Oursler and released by Williams in 1987. This game features a firefighting theme inspired by the Great Chicago Fire of 1871, with art by Mark Sprenger and music by Chris Granner. The machine includes two flippers, three pop bumpers, and multiple ramps, along with a three-ball multiball mode.
